rationale: C07 is an exceptionally close drafting template: it predates the child by less than a month and uses essentially the same statutory recital, reciprocity finding, two-part description of covered works, disruption-or-suspension finding, one-year extension, and limitation on copyright term and pre-proclamation liability. The principal material adaptation is substituting Italy and its reciprocity arrangements for Finland. C14 is an earlier copyright-extension version of substantially the same template. C02 shares the extension machinery and distinctive disruption language but applies it to trademark renewals, making it weaker.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Whereas the President is authorized, in accordance with the conditions prescribed in section 9 of title 17 ... to grant an extension of time for fulfillment of the conditions and formalities prescribed by the copyright laws ... with respect to works first produced or published outside the United States ... by nationals of countries which accord substantially equal treatment to citizens of the United States of America
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Whereas the President is authorized, in accordance with the conditions prescribed in section 9 of title 17 ... to grant an extension of time for fulfillment of the conditions and formalities prescribed by the copyright laws ... with respect to works first produced or published outside the United States ... by nationals of countries which accord substantially equal treatment to citizens of the United States of America
shared_material.explanation: C07 supplies nearly verbatim statutory and reciprocity framing.

shared_material.child_excerpt: with respect to (1) works of citizens of Italy which were first produced or published outside the United States of America on or after September 3, 1939 ... and (2) works of citizens of Italy subject to renewal of copyright ... on or after September 3, 1939
shared_material.parent_excerpt: with respect to (1) works of citizens of Finland which were first produced or published outside the United States of America on or after September 3, 1939 ... and (2) works of citizens of Finland subject to renewal of copyright ... on or after September 3, 1939
shared_material.explanation: The operative scope follows the same two-part sequence, with only the nationality changed.

shared_material.child_excerpt: there has existed during several years of the time since September 3, 1939, such disruption or suspension of facilities essential to compliance ... and that, accordingly, the time ... is hereby extended ... for one year after the date of this proclamation
shared_material.parent_excerpt: there has existed during several years of the time since September 3, 1939, such disruption or suspension of facilities essential to compliance ... and that, accordingly, the time ... is hereby extended ... for one year after the date of this proclamation
shared_material.explanation: This is the same substantive finding and remedy in virtually identical language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the term of copyright in any case is not and cannot be altered or affected by this proclamation ... no liability shall attach ... for lawful uses made or acts done prior to the effective date ... or ... continuance for one year ... of any business undertaking or enterprise lawfully entered into
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the term of copyright in any case is not and cannot be altered or affected by this proclamation ... no liability shall attach ... for lawful uses made or acts done prior to the effective date ... or ... continuance for one year ... of any business undertaking or enterprise lawfully entered into
shared_material.explanation: C07 also contains the child's detailed limitation and reliance-protection paragraph almost word for word.
